a.lede: The decision comes after California banned Waymo's driverless vehicles from operating on the state's highways following a series of traffic incidents.
a.title: Waymo pulls driverless taxis from all US freeways

b.lede: Robotaxi operator suspends driverless rides on high-speed roads nationwide after construction zone incursions and a run-in with patrol vehicles
b.title: California tells Waymo to take the next exit after freeway mishaps
